effect.name: GM Heatmap Scanner
effect.desc: Analytical thermal palette with live isotherm contours, scanning probe band and detail-preserving fusion.
effect.shader: vec3 pal(float t){vec3 c=clamp(abs(fract(t+vec3(0,.67,.33))*6.0-3.0)-1.0,0.0,1.0);return c*c*(3.0-2.0*c);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float l=clamp((dot(src.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))-.5)*range+.5+temperature*.25,0.0,1.0);vec3 thermal=pal(l*.82+.08);float iso=isotherms>0.5?pow(.5+.5*cos(l*isotherms*6.2831853),12.0)*lineStrength:0.0;float scan=exp(-pow((uv.y-scanPosition)/max(scanWidth,.001),2.0));thermal=mix(thermal,vec3(1),iso+scan*.35);thermal=mix(thermal,thermal*src.rgb,detail);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,thermal,mixAmount),src.a);}
